# Markdown in a PDF Some *emphasis*, some **strong** text, a ~~deleted~~ word, a [link](https://lpdf.io) and `inline code`, and one ***bold italic*** word. A soft break is a space, but a break
starts a new line. ## Second level ### Third level #### Fourth level ##### Fifth level ###### Sixth level --- - A disc - Another disc - A circle - Another circle - A third disc 3. Starts at three 4. And goes on - [x] A task that is done - [ ] A task that is not - A plain item in the same list > A quote that stays together, with a bar the height of both of its paragraphs. > > The second paragraph of the quote. ``` fn main() { println!("Indented code keeps its spaces"); } ``` | Name | Qty | Note | |:-------|----:|:------:| | Pen | 2 | blue | | Ink | 10 | black | | Paper | 500 | A4
